news.name: Bengals Unveil Orange Jersey Look for Home Opener vs. Buccaneers
news.summary: The Bengals are bringing back their popular orange jersey and white pants combo for the third straight year at their September 13 home opener against the Tampa Bay Buccaneers. Official posts captioned 'Ready for orange' and 'Orange rising' feature the stars in the gear, while fans praise it as the team's best uniform yet and skip the full orange pants overload. Supporters are decking out rooms with Chase's No. 1 and Burrow's No. 9 jerseys, sharing hype memes, and chanting 'Who Dey' in anticipation of the 1 p.m. ET kickoff.

news.hook: Philadelphia Eagles fans lit up when they heard Tom Brady and Kevin Burkhardt are bringing FOX's top broadcast to their home opener. It's the perfect spotlight for Jalen Hurts and the team at Lincoln Financial Field.
news.name: FOX's Top Crew with Tom Brady Calls Eagles-Commanders Opener
news.summary: The Eagles host the Washington Commanders in Week 1's America's Game of the Week, kicking off at 4:25 p.m. ET on Sunday. FOX assigns its lead team—Kevin Burkhardt on play-by-play, Tom Brady analyzing, and sideline reporters Erin Andrews and Tom Rinaldi—for the NFC East clash at the Linc, where Philly enters as 5.5-point favorites. Fans are thrilled about the national showcase, Brady's expert takes in his third season with Burkhardt, and the early test for the roster.

news.hook: After months sidelined by ankle surgery, Colts wide receiver Alec Pierce is back and ready, coach Shane Steichen confirmed with a simple 'He should be good to go.'
news.name: Colts' Alec Pierce Cleared for Season Opener After Ankle Surgery
news.summary: Pierce missed training camp and preseason following left ankle and heel surgery in late March but returned to practice on Aug. 27 and has now completed about five sessions. The star receiver, who led the NFL in yards per reception at 21.3 last season on his new four-year, $114 million deal, brings a vital deep threat to quarterback Daniel Jones' offense in the home opener against the Ravens at Lucas Oil Stadium. Steichen plans to monitor his workload, possibly easing him in with help from veterans like Keenan Allen, but expects meaningful snaps Sunday at 1 p.m. ET.

news.hook: With the Steelers' season opener just days away, Joey Porter Jr. and the team are pushing for a contract extension amid a skyrocketing cornerback market.
news.name: Steelers Offer Joey Porter Jr. Extension as Deadline Looms
news.summary: Pittsburgh has extended a contract offer to their standout cornerback Joey Porter Jr., a 2023 second-round pick coming off a strong 2025 coverage season, but the two sides remain far apart. The market is heating up, highlighted by the Patriots' $135 million deal with Christian Gonzalez at $33.75 million per year, followed closely by others like Devon Witherspoon at $33 million annually. ESPN's Ian Rapoport holds cautious hope for a pre-Week 1 resolution on September 13 against Atlanta, while former Steeler James Harrison doubts Porter Jr. will accept less than top money; no trade interest has emerged, and the team's no in-season talks policy adds urgency as Porter recovers from a back issue.

news.hook: Two fresh-faced rookies cracked the Falcons' starting defense just in time for their season opener against the Steelers. It's a clear nod to the team's push to unleash young talent right out of the gate.
news.name: Falcons Rookies Daniels and Terrell Nab Week 1 Defensive Starts
news.summary: The Atlanta Falcons released their Week 1 depth chart, slotting rookie inside linebacker Kendal Daniels next to veteran Divine Deablo and second-round cornerback Avieon Terrell into the nickel spot. Daniels, a fourth-round pick from Oklahoma, earned the role over Christian Harris with his standout camp physicality, while Terrell, brother of starter A.J. Terrell, impressed with versatility ahead of veterans like Billy Bowman Jr. Three rookies overall should see starting or big minutes, including Brandon Dorlus at defensive end, as the team heads to Acrisure Stadium Sunday to face Pittsburgh—signaling an aggressive youth movement on defense.

news.hook: Football fans gear up for an early treat as the New England Patriots face the defending champion Seattle Seahawks in a Super Bowl rematch on Wednesday night.
news.name: NFL 2026 Season Opens Wednesday with Patriots-Seahawks Rematch
news.summary: The league kicks off its 2026 season on September 9 with the rare Wednesday opener at 8:20 p.m. ET on NBC and Peacock, letting Seattle play first after their title win. Thursday brings the San Francisco 49ers versus Los Angeles Rams in the first regular-season game in Australia at Melbourne Cricket Ground, airing on Netflix. The Week 1 slate spans four days, ending Monday with Denver Broncos at Kansas City Chiefs, drawing mixed reactions from thrilled predictions to gripes about ditching Sunday tradition.

news.hook: Jets fans marked 246 days since their last game week, ready to face former coach Robert Saleh now leading the Titans in Nashville.
news.name: Jets Face Ex-Coach Saleh's Titans in NFL Season Opener
news.summary: The New York Jets kick off the 2026 NFL season Sunday against the Tennessee Titans at 1 p.m. ET on CBS and Paramount+, with Saleh making his Titans debut against his old team. The Jets, under second-year coach Aaron Glenn and quarterback Geno Smith after a 3-14 season, meet a young Titans squad with second-year QB Cam Ward following back-to-back poor years. Fans trade bold predictions, from Jets hopefuls eyeing a strong start to Titans backers touting their home 'Ring of Fire' edge.
